# dashen_ui_kit

A local-only EXOFRAME UI kit for terminal, CRT, ASCII, palette modules, component docs, HTML PPT decks, and Codex skills.

## Primary URLs

- Showcase: https://cat9999aaa.github.io/dashen_ui_kit/
- English showcase: https://cat9999aaa.github.io/dashen_ui_kit/en.html
- Component docs: https://cat9999aaa.github.io/dashen_ui_kit/docs/site/
- English component docs: https://cat9999aaa.github.io/dashen_ui_kit/docs/site/en.html
- HTML PPT example: https://cat9999aaa.github.io/dashen_ui_kit/docs/deck/exoframe-html-ppt.html
- English HTML PPT example: https://cat9999aaa.github.io/dashen_ui_kit/docs/deck/exoframe-html-ppt.en.html

## What This Project Is

- Local-only front-end UI kit.
- Original EXOFRAME visual language.
- Terminal, CRT, ASCII, prose, code, motion, print, and HTML deck surfaces.
- Independent palette modules and typed package exports.
- Installable Codex skill at `skill/`.

## Use Cases

- Build a retro-futurist local UI.
- Reuse palette-driven components.
- Create browser-native HTML PPT decks instead of .pptx files.
- Install `$exoframe-ui` as a local Codex skill.
